children: Vireo Growth closed a $60 million secured term loan with Needham Bank at a fixed 8.50% rate to refinance existing debt and purchase the Palatka, Florida property. The facility features six months of interest-only payments followed by amortization on a ten-year schedule, with final maturity on Apr 2, 2034, and includes limited prepayment premiums for certain third-party refinancings within three years. Concurrently, the company repaid in full the $49 million Seller Note held by IIP-NY 2 without penalty, removing that lender and consolidating senior liens with Needham Bank.
: Secured term loan facility ($60 million) at fixed 8.50%
: Refinance existing debt and acquire Palatka property
: Seller Note and related mortgage financing
: Refresnced with new Needham Bank term loan
